resources.string: A one-minute game: you\'re X, the battalion commander is O

string-array.name: g_tt_start
string-array.item: Your move. The commander waits, like at formation.
You go first. The commander is generous today.

string-array.name: g_tt_move
string-array.item: The commander placed an O and went for coffee.
Commander: “That was the plan.”
The commander thought for 0.3 seconds. Like over a leave request.
The commander blocks. Like your leave.

string-array.name: g_tt_win
string-array.item: You won! Surprised, the commander signed your leave request.
Three in a row! The commander says it was a drill.

string-array.name: g_tt_lose
string-array.item: The commander won. Says it\'s for your own good.
The O\'s win. Request returned for revision.

string-array.name: g_tt_draw
string-array.item: A draw. Both go for a smoke break.
A draw. The rotation is postponed again.

resources.string: Guess whether the next chance of leave will be higher. Seven in a row and the leave is yours!
That\'s the chance of leave right now. Will the next one be higher or lower?

string-array.name: g_hl_right
string-array.item: Right! The forecasters are nervous.
Yes! You can see the rotation coming.
Exactly. The commander asks how you knew.

string-array.name: g_hl_wrong
string-array.item: No. The forecast changed without warning, as always.
Missed. The streak was returned for revision.

resources.string: Seven in a row! Leave approved 🏖 Tap to play again.
Thor hits everything in sight with his hammer. And then…

string-array.name: g_th_lines
string-array.item: Thor hit a cloud. It started raining.
Thor hit a leave request. It signed itself.
Thor fixed the generator. One blow.
Thor hit the queue at the public office. The queue parted.
Thor hammered a nail into the meeting room wall. Now there\'s a painting.
Thor hit the 05:45 alarm. It doesn\'t ring any more.
Thor opened the jam jar. On the second blow.
Thor hit a drum. The meeting room residents are dancing.
Thor cracked a nut. The squirrel is shocked.
Thor hit the anvil. The neighbours aren\'t shocked, they\'re used to it.
Thor broke the ice. In a talk with his mother-in-law.
Thor swings once more…

resources.string: (Thor stops and looks straight into the camera)
Tap to let Thor play on
